title: Phase 6 – Meta-Game: Campfire, Trophy Room & Campaign

systems.name: 6.1 The Campfire (Lobby)
systems.notes: The pre-game lobby where the party strategises. The Mimic exists as the campfire itself, listening to all communication. Atmospheric, immersive.
tasks: Design campfire scene (visual: dark forest clearing, animated fire)
Open voice/text chat for all players during campfire phase
Mimic hidden: no visible presence, but hears all communication
Ready-up system and chapter start countdown

systems.name: 6.2 The Trophy Room (Mimic Meta-Screen)
systems.notes: The Mimic's persistent meta-screen showing collected skulls. Each skull is labelled with the player's name and chapter. Goal is accumulation across the campaign.
tasks: Design Trophy Room UI (dark, collector aesthetic, shelves of skulls)
Each skull displays: player name, class, chapter eliminated
New skull added with animation after each elimination
Skull count tracked across entire campaign

systems.name: 6.3 Campaign Structure & Chapters
systems.notes: Design the full campaign: 5–8 chapters with escalating difficulty, new dungeon themes, and narrative beats. Each chapter introduces new mechanics or enemies.
tasks: Chapter 2: The Catacombs (introduce traps and ghost mechanics)
Chapter 3: The Archives (tight corridors, social deduction pressure)
Chapter 5: The Sanctum (final chapter, high stakes, unique boss encounter)

systems.name: 6.4 End-of-Campaign Scoring & Stats
systems.notes: After the final chapter, display campaign stats: survivors, skulls collected, party achievements, Mimic's most effective tactics.
tasks: Campaign summary screen with stats and highlights
Mimic score: skulls collected, successful ambushes, deception rate
Party score: chapters survived, spirit checks passed, traps avoided
Hall of Fame: top Mimics and top Survivors
